23433-the-kitten-s-garden-of-verses.creator: Unknown
23433-the-kitten-s-garden-of-verses.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Fancy 49   In Darkest Africa 51   The Dog 55   The Game 59  The Kitten's Garden _of_ Verses  [Illustration]  Winter and Summer    In Winter when the air is chill,  And winds are blowing loud and shrill,  All snug and warm I sit and purr,  Wrapped in my overcoat of fur. In Summer quite the other way,  I find it very hot all day,  But Human People do not care,  For they have nice thin clothes to wear.

arxiv-2001-07145.title: Distributed Possibilistic Learning in Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv-2001-07145.creator: Jonathan Lawry 1, Michael Crosscombe 1† and David Harvey 2
arxiv-2001-07145.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jonathan Lawry 1, Michael Crosscombe 1† and David Harvey 2. Possibility theory is proposed as an uncertainty representation framework for distributed learning in multi-agent systems and robot swarms. In particular, we investigate its application to the best-of- n n problem where the aim is for a population of agents to identify the highest quality out of n n options through local interactions between individuals and limited direct feedback from the environment.

arxiv-2010-15258.title: DNSMOS: A Non-Intrusive Perceptual Objective Speech Quality metric to evaluate Noise Suppressors
arxiv-2010-15258.creator: Chandan K A Reddy, Vishak Gopal, Ross Cutler
arxiv-2010-15258.description: Abstract Human subjective evaluation is the “gold standard” to evaluate speech quality optimized for human perception. Perceptual objective metrics serve as a proxy for subjective scores. The conventional and widely used metrics require a reference clean speech signal, which is unavailable in real recordings.

arxiv-2211-10830.title: Discrete Lagrangian Neural Networks with Automatic Symmetry Discovery
arxiv-2211-10830.creator: Yana Lishkova † \dagger, Paul Scherer † \dagger, Steffen Ridderbusch, Mateja Jamnik, Pietro Liò, Sina Ober-Blöbaum, Christian Offen
arxiv-2211-10830.description: Abstract By one of the most fundamental principles in physics, a dynamical system will exhibit those motions which extremise an action functional. This leads to the formation of the Euler-Lagrange equations, which serve as a model of how the system will behave in time.

arxiv-2310-12973.title: Frozen Transformers in Language Models Are Effective Visual Encoder Layers
arxiv-2310-12973.creator: Ziqi Pang Ziyang Xie, Yunze ManYu-Xiong WangUniversity of Illinois Urbana-Champaign {ziqip2,ziyang8,yunzem2,yxw}@illinois.edu https://github.com/ziqipang/LM4VisualEncoding
arxiv-2310-12973.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ziqi Pang Ziyang Xie, Yunze ManYu-Xiong WangUniversity of Illinois Urbana-Champaign {ziqip2,ziyang8,yunzem2,yxw}@illinois.edu https://github.com/ziqipang/LM4VisualEncoding. This paper reveals that large language models (LLMs), despite being trained solely on text data, are surprisingly strong encoders for purely visual tasks in the absence of language. Even more intriguingly, this can be achieved by a simple yet previously overlooked strategy – employing a frozen transformer block from pre-trained LLMs as a constituent encoder layer to directly process visual tokens.

arxiv-2405-13711.title: VAE-Var: Variational-Autoencoder-Enhanced Variational Assimilation
arxiv-2405-13711.creator: Yi Xiao, Qilong Jia, Wei Xue, Lei Bai
arxiv-2405-13711.description: Abstract Data assimilation refers to a set of algorithms designed to compute the optimal estimate of a system’s state by refining the prior prediction (known as background states) using observed data. Variational assimilation methods rely on the maximum likelihood approach to formulate a variational cost, with the optimal state estimate derived by minimizing this cost.

arxiv-2409-05842.title: Finite-size topological phases from semimetals
arxiv-2409-05842.creator: Adipta Pal, Ashley M. Cook
arxiv-2409-05842.description: Abstract Topological semimetals are some of the topological phases of matter most intensely-studied experimentally. The Weyl semimetal phase, in particular, has garned tremendous, sustained interest given fascinating signatures such as the Fermi arc surface states and the chiral anomaly, as well as the minimal requirements to protect this three-dimensional topological phase.

arxiv-2509-24406.title: Muon: Training and Trade-offs with Latent Attention and MoE
arxiv-2509-24406.creator: Sushant Mehta, Raj Dandekar, Rajat Dandekar, Sreedath Panat
arxiv-2509-24406.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive theoretical and empirical study of the Muon optimizer for training transformers only with a small to medium decoder (30M - 200M parameters), with an emphasis on its mathematical foundations, convergence properties and interactions with modern architectural optimizations.

arxiv-2510-02853.title: The Principle of Isomorphism: A Theory of Population Activity in Grid Cells and Beyond
arxiv-2510-02853.creator: Maoshen Xu, Fei Song, Yuxiu Shao, Bailu Si, Shanshan Qin
arxiv-2510-02853.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maoshen Xu, Fei Song, Yuxiu Shao, Bailu Si, Shanshan Qin. Identifying the principles that determine neural population activity is paramount in the field of neuroscience. We propose the P rinciple of Iso morphism (PIso): population activity preserves the essential mathematical structures of the tasks it supports. Using grid cells as a model system, we show that the neural metric task is characterized by a flat Riemannian manifold, while path integration is characterized by an Abelian Lie group.

We hypothesized that due to the COVID-19 pandemic, SSTI rates would significantly decrease due to directives to avoid unneeded care and attenuated SSTIs risk behaviours. We retrospectively examined all patients with an ICD-10 diagnosis code in the Los Angeles County Department of Health Services, the second largest U.S.

pmc-11340008.title: Facile synthesis of N-doped graphene quantum dots as a fluorescent sensor for Cr(vi) and folic acid detection†
pmc-11340008.creator: Chu-Sen Ni, Wen-Jie Zhang, Wen-Zhu Bi, Ming-Xia Wu, Su-Xiang Feng, Xiao-Lan Chen, Ling-Bo Qu
pmc-11340008.description: The development of stable fluorescent sensors for toxic pollutants and drugs is meaningful to the environment and public health. In this work, nitrogen-doped graphene quantum dots (N-GQDs) were facially synthesized by a one-step hydrothermal method using soluble starch and l-arginine as carbon and nitrogen sources in pure water at 190 °C for 4 h.

pmc-11569137.title: Comparisons between Caucasian-validated and Chinese-validated photo-numeric scales for assessing facial wrinkles
pmc-11569137.creator: Jun Yan Ng, Hongyu Zhou, Tianqi Li, Fook Tim Chew
pmc-11569137.description: Skin ageing results in wrinkling. In this study, we discuss four types of facial wrinkles: Crow’s Feet wrinkles, forehead wrinkles, glabellar frown wrinkles, and nasolabial folds. These four phenotypes can be assessed either with a photo-numeric scale developed and validated on Caucasian skin (i.e., Caucasian scale) or with a photo-numeric scale developed and validated on Chinese skin (i.e., Chinese scale).

pmc-11582743.title: Addressing heterogeneity in the development of circular economy strategies in the offshore wind industry: A review
pmc-11582743.creator: Pankaj Ravindra Gode, Arild Aspelund
pmc-11582743.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). To mitigate the impact of climate change, a transition to renewables in the energy sector is needed. Offshore wind energy is a promising renewable technology that is developing at an unprecedented rate. However, the offshore wind industry is material intensive, and there are concerns about its end-of-life strategies and that we might end up exchanging a climate challenge with a material challenge.

pmc-12405522.title: A Nostalgia Brain-Music Interface for enhancing nostalgia, well-being, and memory vividness in younger and older individuals
pmc-12405522.creator: Yuna Sakakibara, Tomohiro Kusutomi, Sotaro Kondoh, Takahide Etani, Saori Shimada, Yasuhiko Imamura, Yasushi Naruse, Shinya Fujii, Takuya Ibaraki
pmc-12405522.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Music-evoked nostalgia has the potential to assist in recalling autobiographical memories and enhancing well-being. However, nostalgic music preferences vary from person to person, presenting challenges for applying nostalgia-based music interventions in clinical settings, such as a non-pharmacological approach. To address these individual differences, we developed the Nostalgia Brain-Music Interface (N-BMI), a neurofeedback system that recommends nostalgic songs tailored to each individual.

pmc-12575001.title: OpenSpliceAI provides an efficient modular implementation of SpliceAI enabling easy retraining across nonhuman species
pmc-12575001.creator: Kuan-Hao Chao, Alan Mao, Anqi Liu, Steven L Salzberg, Mihaela Pertea, Peter Koo, Kuan-Hao Chao, Alan Mao, Anqi Liu, Steven L Salzberg, Mihaela Pertea
pmc-12575001.description: The SpliceAI deep learning system is currently one of the most accurate methods for identifying splicing signals directly from DNA sequences. However, its utility is limited by its reliance on older software frameworks and human-centric training data. Here, we introduce OpenSpliceAI, a trainable, open-source version of SpliceAI implemented in PyTorch to address these challenges.

pmc-13147391.title: Unraveling the hidden world: Variability and complexity of holopelagic Sargassum biofilms
pmc-13147391.creator: Zujaila Nohemy Qui-Minet, Christine Paillard, Valérie Michotey, Solène Connan, Philippe Elíes, Valérie Stiger-Pouvreau
pmc-13147391.description: Holopelagic Sargassum spp. —including S. natans var. natans (SNN), S. natans var. wingei (SNW), and S. fluitans var. fluitans (SFF)—have become a major ecological and socio-economic concern due to recurrent mass strandings in the Caribbean. This study aims to complement the growing knowledge on the holopelagic Sargassum holobiont by incorporating the three-dimensional organization of its biofilms.

pmc-13240672.title: Molecular Mechanisms of Manganese Oxide Nanoparticles Toxicity in Brain and Other Tissues: An Overview
pmc-13240672.creator: Michael Aschner, Anatoly V. Skalny, Svetlana V. Notova, Margarita N. Tinkova, Rongzhu Lu, Andrey A. Skalny, Abel Santamaria, Ji-Chang Zhou, Alexey A. Tinkov
pmc-13240672.description: The use of manganese oxide nanoparticles (MnOxNPs) in biomedicine increases the risk of their accumulation in the body, potentially leading to toxicity in various organs and tissues. In addition, occupational exposure to MnOxNPs-containing aerosols may also occur. MnOxNPs have been shown to accumulate in the brain and induce neurobehavioral alterations.

uslaw-usc-t19-s81b.title: 19 U.S.C. § 81b — Establishment of zones
uslaw-usc-t19-s81b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t19-s81b.description: United States Code, Title 19 (Customs Duties); Chapter 1A (Foreign Trade Zones). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Board authorization to grant zones The Board is authorized, subject to the conditions and restrictions of this chapter and of the rules and regulations made thereunder, upon application as hereinafter provided, to grant to corporations the privilege of establishing, operating, and maintaining foreign-trade zones.
